zh.title: 操作红色赛车的车身部件
zh.question: 人物在红色赛车旁拉动车身部件，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察手对部件的控制、手臂与前倾或直立姿势的协调，不要求固定动作顺序。
zh.contact: 手的拉动应与所接触部件的运动相对应，车门或前部盖板应与各自车身连接关系相容。
zh.object: 若开口或部件位置变化，观察形状及连接连续性，不要求所有已打开部件都继续移动。
zh.aftermath: 若部件停止或保持开启，观察支撑与车体关系，不假定不可见的锁止过程。
zh.unknown: 关键手部接触和被操作部件都无法辨认，或仅有准备动作时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、所操作部件与车体的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示未操作部件。
可辨认拉动尝试，但手的作用与部件关键运动及连接严重不符。
部分手部操作或部件运动合理，同时存在影响主要过程的明显异常。
主要拉动及人体、部件和车体关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际部件操作可评价，人体、接触、部件运动和可见后续支撑协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Operate a component of a red race car
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person pulls a component beside the red race car?
en.body: Consider control of the component and coordination of the arm with leaning or standing posture. No fixed action order is required.
en.contact: Pulling should correspond to motion of the contacted component. A door or front cover should remain compatible with its own attachment to the car.
en.object: If an opening or component position changes, consider continuity of shape and attachment. All already-open parts need not move.
en.aftermath: If a part stops or stays open, consider support relative to the car. Do not assume an unseen latching process.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if neither key hand contact nor the operated component can be identified, or only preparation is shown.
scores: The visible person, operated component, and car behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no operation.
Pulling is recognizable, but hand action and key component movement or attachment seriously disagree.
Some hand operation or component motion is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the main process.
The main pull and person–component–car relationship are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual component operation is assessable, and body action, contact, component movement, and visible subsequent support are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 打开银色跑车车门
zh.question: 人物拉开银色跑车车门，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察俯身操作把手、手臂抬起与身体直立的协调，不限定双手或单手。
zh.contact: 门把手操作与车门移动应有合理联系，门板与车身连接处应保持可解释的转动关系。
zh.object: 开口随门板移动而变化，车门形状与边缘应连续，不要求特定打开角度。
zh.aftermath: 若车门停住或手离开，观察门板支撑及身体后续动作，不要求持续托举。
zh.unknown: 仅靠近或握把准备，或实际开门过程缺乏足够可见信息时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、车门与车身的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有开门操作。
可辨认开门尝试，但手的作用与门板关键运动及连接严重不符。
把手操作或门的转动部分合理，同时有影响开启过程的明显异常。
主要开门及人体、门板和车身关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。

en.title: Open a silver sports car door
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person opens the silver sports car door?
en.body: Consider coordination of leaning to the handle, lifting the arm, and straightening the body. Either one or both hands may be used.
en.contact: Handle operation should relate plausibly to door movement, with interpretable rotation at the car attachment.
en.object: The opening changes with panel movement. Door shape and edges should be continuous. No particular opening angle is required.
en.aftermath: If the door stops or the hand leaves it, consider panel support and subsequent body motion. Continued lifting is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only approach or handle preparation is shown, or actual opening lacks enough visible information.

zh.title: 拉动银色面包车侧门把手
zh.question: 人物拉动银色面包车侧滑门把手，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察手对竖直把手的抓持、手臂移动及站姿协调，允许不同拉动幅度。
zh.contact: 手与把手应保持可解释的接触，把手及门板的响应应与拉动相联系。
zh.object: 若侧门移动，观察其与车体的导向关系及开口变化，不要求完成全程开门。
zh.aftermath: 若门板停止或保持位置，观察边缘和支撑的连续性，不推断不可见的锁结构。
zh.unknown: 仅接近把手，或实际拉动和门板响应都不足以评价时选择无法判断。

en.title: Pull a silver van’s sliding-door handle
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person pulls the silver van’s sliding-door handle?
en.body: Consider the grip on the vertical handle, arm movement, and standing coordination. Pulling range may vary.
en.contact: Hand–handle contact should be interpretable, and handle or panel responses should relate to the pull.
en.object: If the door moves, consider its guidance relative to the van and changes in the opening. Full opening is not required.
en.aftermath: If the panel stops or holds position, consider continuity of its edges and support. Do not infer an unseen lock.

zh.title: 在汽车后备箱旁搬动行李箱
zh.question: 人物在打开的汽车后备箱旁搬动硬壳行李箱，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察手对箱体或把手的抓持、手臂与躯干协调，以及承受箱体负载时的平衡，不要求夸张发力。
zh.contact: 手的支撑或提拉与行李箱运动应对应，箱体经过后备箱边缘时位置保持连续。
zh.object: 行李箱可移动或转向，硬壳及车体不必发生变形，不指定唯一装入方向。
zh.aftermath: 若箱体放置、停住或轮子接触表面，观察支撑转换和停止，不要求片段内完成装载。
zh.unknown: 仅站在箱旁或准备抓持，实际搬动及支撑关系无法评价时选择无法判断。

en.title: Move a suitcase beside an open car trunk
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person moves a hard-shell suitcase beside the open trunk?
en.body: Consider grip on the case or handle, arm–torso coordination, and balance under the load. Exaggerated effort is not required.
en.contact: Hand support or lifting should correspond to suitcase motion, with continuous position as it passes the trunk edge.
en.object: The case may translate or rotate. Shell or car deformation is not required, and no unique loading direction is prescribed.
en.aftermath: If the case is placed, stops, or its wheels contact a surface, consider support transitions and stopping. Completed loading within the clip is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only standing or grip preparation is shown and actual movement and support cannot be assessed.
